stage: E1B lifecycle-stage phenotype (sealed addendum to AP-002_E1B_PHENOTYPE_REVIEW_P03)

reconciliation.per_cell_reconciliation: every touched-fill cell equals prior E1B fill anchor count minus gap-through count per stratum (e.g. 30s: 99,224 - 213 = 99,011; 1h h5 outcome 481 - 4 = 477); 4h touched-fill cell (n=141) is identical to the full 4h FILL cohort because gap-through = 0

predeclared_support_rule.artifact_note: rule fixed before inspecting per-cell aggregates; labels carry no significance meaning

basis.fact_check_acknowledgment: The mechanical fact check (E1B_INTERPRETER_FACT_CHECK.json) verified all three P-03 sign-count claims as TRUE (FIRST_TOUCH direction-adjusted p50 positive 21/21; FILL 21/21; FILL > FIRST_TOUCH in 19/21 of 21 cells); no corrections were issued against P-03.

q1_touched_fill_vs_gap_through_descripti.answer: No robust descriptive difference is supported. At the only two strata where both populations carry the predeclared DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE label (15s and 30s), the two populations show the same weak, positive-leaning central tendency; where they differ (30s), the difference is stratum-inconsistent, small relative to dispersion, and hypothesis-grade only.

direct_observations.text: 15s (touched n=226,210; gap-through n=682; both DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE): direction-adjusted p50 h1/h3/h5 = touched +0.0217/+0.0661/+0.0848 bps vs gap-through 0.0/+0.0716/+0.1902 bps. The ordering flips across horizons (gap-through lower-or-equal at h1, near-identical at h3, higher at h5); every value is a small fraction of the respective IQRs (touched h1 IQR [-0.839, +0.910]; gap-through h1 IQR [-0.850, +0.864]). Path: E1B_FILL_STRATIFICATION.json cells[tf=15s, TOUCHED_FILL / GAP_THROUGH_FILL].horizons[h].direction_adjusted_return_bps.p50.

30s (touched n=99,011; gap-through n=213; both DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE): direction-adjusted p50 h1/h3/h5 = touched +0.0298/+0.1077/+0.1607 bps vs gap-through +0.8894/+1.3700/+0.8009 bps - gap-through uniformly higher (5-13x at h1/h3), with sign-consistent positive medians at all three horizons. Gap-through dispersion is also wider (h1 p05 -3.93 to p95 +15.14 vs touched -4.94 to +5.14), and the h1 median difference (0.86 bps) remains small against the gap-through h1 IQR [-0.800, +5.204]. Path: cells[tf=30s].horizons.

Direction composition of the gap-through cells: bullish share 350/682 = 51.3% (15s) and 119/213 = 55.9% (30s), versus 51.0% (115,315/226,210) and 51.1% (51,116/99,011) in the touched-fill cells. The 30s gap-through cell is modestly bullish-overweight, and the P-03 review established the post-fill positive lean is bullish-carried.

Mixture-negligibility check (closes P-03's unverified expectation): pooled FILL direction-adjusted p50 (E1B_RESULTS.json) minus touched-fill-only p50 (this artifact) is at most ~0.002 bps across all shared cells (e.g. 15s h1: 0.0214 vs 0.0217; 30s h3: 0.1092 vs 0.1077; 1m h1: identical to 6 decimals), consistent with gap-through being 0.19-0.83% of fills.
The 1m gap-through cell (n=81, DESCRIPTIVE_THIN) shows non-monotone, sign-flipping medians (0.0/-0.942/+2.469 bps) - already unstable at n=81, illustrating why the predeclared labels matter.

The 5m (n=20), 15m (n=10), 1h (n=4) gap-through cells are predeclared TOO_SPARSE_FOR_COMPARISON and the 4h cell is EMPTY (n=0). Their quantiles are deliberately not quoted here and carry zero interpretive weight.

interpretation.text: Taken together: at 15s the two fill populations are descriptively indistinguishable (weak positive lean, ordering flips by horizon); at 30s gap-through medians are uniformly higher but the pattern (a) rests on n=213, (b) sits inside a wide IQR, (c) is confounded by a modest bullish composition overweight, and (d) is contradicted by the 15s null. A stratum-inconsistent, single-stratum pattern is not a descriptive difference; it is a registered hypothesis. The load-bearing P-03 characterization of post-fill behavior (weak, sign-consistent, bullish-carried, in-zone-direction lean) applies to both populations where comparison is lawful.

q1_touched_fill_vs_gap_through_descripti.hypothesis_for_later_testing: Does gap-through fill exhibit a systematically larger post-fill direction-adjusted response than touched-fill at strata where both are adequately sampled (P-03 QG-2, now partially answered: no robust difference at 15s/30s; suggestive-only at 30s)?

q2_strata_with_sufficient_n.answer: Using the predeclared eligibility labels (rule: anchor_n >= 200 = DESCRIPTIVE_ADEQUATE; 30-199 = DESCRIPTIVE_THIN; 1-29 = TOO_SPARSE_FOR_COMPARISON; 0 = EMPTY; rule fixed before per-cell inspection): a touched-fill vs gap-through descriptive comparison is adequately supported ONLY at 15s (682 vs 226,210) and 30s (213 vs 99,011).
q2_strata_with_sufficient_n.note: Labels are denominators-based support labels only; they carry no significance meaning (artifact note). Touched-fill alone is adequate at 15s-1h and thin at 4h, matching the P-03 small-N caveats on 4h.

q3_impact_on_prior_p03_conclusions.answer: No major P-03 conclusion changes. The new evidence closes the one scope limitation P-03 recorded (AN-5 / gap-through outcomes unmeasured) and confirms the expectation P-03 had flagged as unverified (the 0.19-0.83% gap-through mixture negligibly moves pooled FILL quantiles). One new hypothesis-grade observation is registered (30s gap-through medians uniformly higher); it is stratum-inconsistent and changes nothing established.
unchanged_conclusions: Stage sign flip (formation 18-negative-of-21 to FIRST_TOUCH/FILL 21/21 positive) - unchanged; fact-check verified all P-03 sign counts TRUE.
Weak-central-tendency characterization (medians small vs dispersion; bullish-carried) - unchanged; the stratified touched-fill medians reproduce the pooled medians within ~0.002 bps.
Tail/censoring ceilings and the no-unconditional-p99-beyond-1m rule - unchanged (this addendum introduces no duration data).
Development split assessment and must-not-claim list - unchanged and extended (below).

refinements.text: P-03 AN-5 (scope-limitation: no per-population FILL outcomes committed) is RESOLVED by E1B_FILL_STRATIFICATION.json; P-03 QG-2 receives a partial descriptive answer: no robust touched-fill vs gap-through difference at the two adequately powered strata.

P-03's statement 'even at 15s (n=682) no per-population outcomes are committed' is superseded: outcomes are now committed at 15s and 30s, and the 15s comparison shows descriptive indistinguishability rather than a difference.

q3_impact_on_prior_p03_conclusions.new_registered_hypothesis: 30s gap-through post-fill medians uniformly exceed touched-fill medians (h1/h3/h5, n=213 vs 99,011) - hypothesis-grade only, stratum-inconsistent (15s shows no difference), composition-confounded (55.9% bullish vs 51.1%).

must_not_claim_addendum_scoped: No alpha/edge/profitable/strategy/signal claims; nothing tested; confirmation LOCKED; E2/E3 NOT STARTED.
The 30s gap-through median pattern is not an established effect (n=213, stratum-inconsistent, composition-confounded).
